deck_title: Max-Hillaire analytical volume step emission-extinction integral vs naive linear dt blowout rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Nelson Max (IEEE TVCG 1995) & Sebastien Hillaire (SIGGRAPH 2016) analytical intra-step volume emission-extinction integration (L_out = L_in * exp(-tau) + (S / sigma_t) * (1 - exp(-tau)), locking Kirchhoff equilibrium radiance R = 1.0000x across all 17 optical depth stations tau = sigma_t * ds in [0.0, 2.0]) versus naive unattenuated step emission (L_out = L_in * exp(-tau) + S * ds = L_eq * (exp(-tau) + tau), which blows out step radiance to 1.1065x at tau=0.50, 1.3679x at tau=1.00, and 2.1353x at tau=2.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-substep RTE micro-slab quadrature.
